subject: Reception and display joinery
hook: Reception desks and display joinery made in Stoke-on-Trent.
gbp:
Starting the year with a refit? SUPERIO designs and makes reception desks, display units and office storage for businesses that want furniture made for their space rather than picked from a catalogue.

It suits offices, salons, clinics, showrooms and shops where the counter is the first thing customers see and the place staff work all day.

What's included:
- A design consultation to understand how your front of house works
- Measuring of the space and the access route in
- Counters with visitor and staff heights, accessible sections, power and data routes
- Matching display shelving and staff storage
- An itemised quote with transparent pricing
- Manufacture in our own workshop in Hanley, Stoke-on-Trent
- Delivery and installation by our own team

Finishes include matt, super matt, gloss and wood-effect boards, with edges finished to match.

Tap Learn more to see our cabinet making service and start a conversation about your premises.
